listing.name: Suitable Star Systems
listing.summary: A mod that adds three star systems to explore and conquer. The first is a perfect star system with planets optimized for colonization. The second is a remnant star system perfect for farming AI cores and experience. The last is a [SUPER REDACTED] system perfect for farming unique weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Adds three star systems optimized for colonization, AI core farming, and unique weapon acquisition.

description:
Suitable Star Systems 2.5.0

Compatibility
Needs a new save
Not compatible with saves on 2.4.4j and below
Not safe to remove mid-game
No known mod conflicts

Integrations
LunaLib - Has native support for mod settings
A mod that adds three star systems to explore and conquer.
The first is a perfect star system with planets optimized for colonization.
The second is a remnant star system perfect for farming AI cores and experience.
The last is a [SUPER REDACTED] system perfect for farming unique weapons.

Previews
Click the image to enlarge

Spoilers
For the omega star system, you need the planet killer and use it on the omega planet to make omega fleets spawn.
The planet killer can be found during the "The Scythe of Orion" quest or through exploration by discovering a star system with a tundra planet called "Sentinel".

Settings
- Option to not spawn any of the three star systems
- Option to manually place the perfect star system
- Option to skip the [SUPER REDACTED] planet interaction

- If you have lunalib, options are in the mod settings
- If you don't have lunalib, options are in the settings.json file located in "thismodname/data/config/..."

If you need help or want to send feedback, you can make a post on this thread.
If you want to support me, you can do so through my Patreon page.

Credits
Wispborne - for the starsector intellij mod template and the github action script.
starsector community - for many resources in regard to modding and spriting.
Alex and Co - for making a great game and community.
